# 03 Core Data Flows

Shiftly relies on an event-driven architecture using Kafka. This ensures that microservices remain decoupled and highly available. Below are visual sequence diagrams illustrating how data flows through the system during critical user journeys.

## User Registration Flow

This flow demonstrates the separation between authentication identity and the domain user profile, coordinated asynchronously via Kafka.

![Mermaid Diagram](https://mermaid.)

## Job Application Flow

This flow highlights how multiple services interact when a candidate applies for a job, involving document parsing and analytics tracking.

![Mermaid Diagram](https://mermaid.)

## The Outbox Pattern (Reliable Event Delivery)

To prevent data loss if Kafka is temporarily unavailable, services employ the **Transactional Outbox Pattern**.

![Mermaid Diagram](https://mermaid.)
